title: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
summary: Central Sector scheme providing direct income support to landholding farmer families across India. Check the official portal for latest eligibility criteria, e-KYC requirements, and installment status.

title: PMFBY (Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
summary: Government-sponsored crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest. Visit the official site for notified crops, premium calculator, and claim reporting.

title: YSR Rythu Bharosa / Annadata Sukhibhava (Andhra Pradesh)
summary: State agricultural investment support and farmer welfare programme in Andhra Pradesh. Check the official state agriculture portal or your local Rythu Seva Kendra / RBK for current guidelines.

title: Rythu Bharosa / Rythu Bandhu (Telangana)
summary: Telangana government farmer investment support scheme per season. Check the official Telangana Agriculture Department portal for current rules and disbursement updates.

title: e-NAM (National Agriculture Market)
summary: Pan-India electronic trading portal networking existing APMC mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities.

title: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) & MyScheme Agriculture Portal
summary: Timely and affordable short-term institutional credit for cultivation, post-harvest expenses, and allied activities. Check official government portals for bank application procedures.

title: Soil Health Card Scheme
summary: Provides soil nutrient status cards and crop-wise fertilizer recommendations to farmers to improve productivity through judicious input use.
